resources.string: Elenii
Elenii
Elenii is an assistive companion. It can be wrong. Always use your cane, guide dog, caregiver support, and your own judgment.
Safety note: Elenii is an assistive companion and may be wrong.
Get started. Learn what Elenii can do.
Elenii is not a replacement for emergency services. Call your local emergency number if you are in immediate danger.
Elenii needs your permission for a few things. We only ask when a feature needs it.
Elenii needs the Bluetooth (Nearby devices) permission to find your glasses. Please allow it to continue.
WhatsApp uses your phone camera. Elenii pauses detection during a call.
Elenii will pause camera detection during the call and resume when you return.
Elenii is back. Camera guidance resumed.
Hello, I need visual assistance on Elenii. Please message me when you can. {lastSceneSummaryText} {locationText}

Hello, I need visual assistance on Elenii. Please start a WhatsApp video call with me and guide me. I will point my phone camera forward so you can see what is ahead. {lastSceneSummaryText} {locationText}
Point your glasses forward. Elenii describes the scene in a short, clear voice cue.
Capture signs, labels, or documents. Elenii reads the text aloud—fully on your phone.
Long-press your glasses, say a command, and Elenii responds—even with the screen locked.
Connect your X01 or HeyCyan glasses. Ask what is ahead, read signs and labels, and use hands-free voice commands—even with the screen locked.
Use your phone camera for live object detection and spoken guidance. Great when you are not wearing glasses or want a larger view.
Switch guidance to Hausa in Model packs. Elenii uses on-device labels in Hausa and can speak with the Hausa voice pack—fully offline.
Add trusted helpers in Settings. From phone camera mode you can open WhatsApp to call or message them with a prefilled note about what you see.
Shows when Elenii is giving periodic guidance while you walk.
Elenii walking mode
Lets you trigger Elenii from your glasses with the screen locked.
Elenii hands-free is on
Allow Elenii to send SMS so saying emergency on your glasses sends help without tapping Send.
